selection_criteria: at least one field matching a frozen model parameter/output
a file small enough to fetch within the 50 MB sample budget
metadata_source: Zenodo REST API GET /api/records/<id> (HTTP 200), read in this session

datasets.title: MicroCT Trabecular Bone Samples for Trabecular Thickness and Separation Measures
datasets.creator: Kuczynski, Michael
datasets.subjects: 9 segmented trabecular-bone volumes (BMLPL_001-005, 007-009; groups REF and BML; no 006 in the record). Species/source and donor count are NOT stated by the record.
datasets.evidence: form/units/coordinate frame and geometry measured in results.json sample_audit

datasets.title: Quantifying the impact of 3D pore space morphology on diffusive mass transport in loam and sand (supplementary data)
datasets.creator: Prifling, Weber, Ray, Prechtel, Phalempin, Schlüter, Vetterlein, Schmidt
datasets.format: characteristics.csv (4608 rows) + segmented_stacks.zip (binarised 3D CT cutouts, 512/256/128 voxels per side)
datasets.subjects: soil cores: loam and sand, several depths; 4608 analysed cutouts (not human)
datasets.evidence: M-factor inverts to tau = sqrt(phi/M); see other_measured_files.

datasets.title: Review of Tortuosity: Classical Theory and Modern Methods (additional information)
datasets.creator: Holzer, Lorenz

datasets.title: BAM reference data: temperature-dependent Young's and shear modulus of AM and conventionally manufactured Ti-6Al-4V
datasets.creator: Rehmer, Bayram, Avila Calderon, Mohr, Skrotzki

datasets.title: Compressive characterization of additively manufactured TPU (and reference PBT) lattice metamaterials: raw and processed data

datasets.title: Imperial College London femur and tibia surface mesh set
datasets.creator: Tsang, Zhang, Nolte, Kedgley, Bull
datasets.format: STL surface meshes inside two zip archives (+ Readme.txt)

datasets.title: Apparent Young's modulus of human cranial cancellous bone
datasets.creator: Marcian, Petr
datasets.format: csv, ';' separated: Fx/Fy/Fz [N], apparent Ex/Ey/Ez [MPa], BV/TV [-]
datasets.subjects: human cranial cancellous bone, 5 compression segments, 39 measurement rows (donor count not stated)

coverage_gaps: No open measured dataset was located for the hydraulic permeability K of trabecular bone or of a Ti scaffold, so the model's headline output K stays unvalidated by data (DS-01 gives geometry only, and K needs a pressure/flow measurement).

No open measured dataset for lambda (consumption rate), g_p (perfusion gradient), mu (viscosity) or sigma_app (compressive stress) was located within the time budget; DS-07 provides forces and apparent modulus but no contact area, so stress is unknown.
No open measured dataset links an AM process state s to the resulting (phi, d) on the same specimen, so the frozen process law (phi(s), d(s), q) has no data support.
The response law (epsilon_peak, epsilon_width, c_50, tau_opt, tau_ratio_width, response_max) is a hypothesis: 6 of 28 parameters have no public measurement and no dataset can make them observable.
not_considered: Internal BodyTwin data (the collaborator's box-lift h5, LHDL, OrthoLoad locally, TLEM, Keast): internal per NIGHT_PREAMBLE.md paragraph 5, out of scope for a public-data audit.
Simulated-only datasets (e.g. OpenCell, Lattice Grain, AM-Bench CT reconstructions) were excluded by the PREREG requirement of measured quantities.

OrthoLoad (in vivo joint contact forces, a public time series) was not used: the host was unreachable from this session (DNS failure, no HTTP status) and its force time series does not measure any Q052 parameter directly.
